progress.summary: AC-1 met. app/api/admin/events/[id]/task-messages/route.ts resolved the event identifier from pathname segment 5, which is the literal trailing route name 'task-messages' rather than the [id] segment at index 4, so GET/POST/PATCH all read, wrote and authorized against event_id = 'task-messages'. All three handlers now resolve the segment that follows the literal 'events' segment, URL-decode it, UUID-validate it, and 400 when it is not an event id. The ADMIN-013 bug class was partly present: no envelope-as-boolean here, but two of the three shapes were. The PATCH 'complete' branch performed no authorization at all (segment repair alone leaves 3 of 10 new tests failing), so it is now gated on sender OR task recipient OR event owner OR admin/manager event participant, with an .eq('event_id') predicate on the update. POST trusted a client-supplied context.eventId over the path id when building action_url, so the resolved id now wins.
completed: Dependency ADMIN-013 satisfied; ADMIN-014 unblocked

resolveEventIdFromRequest added: segment after the literal 'events' segment, URL-decoded, UUID-validated; all three handlers return 400 'Invalid event id' rather than proceeding with an unresolvable resource
POST task link context now spreads validated.context first and eventId last, so a client-supplied context.eventId can no longer override the resolved tenant for action_url

PATCH complete now authorizes sender OR task recipient OR event owner OR admin/manager event participant before mutating, and the completion UPDATE carries an .eq('event_id', eventId) data-boundary predicate to match the read
PATCH complete read switched from .single() to .maybeSingle() so the 404 does not depend on swallowing a PostgREST error

Retired __tests__/admin/admin-profile-column-drift.test.ts's test that pinned the defect (it asserted ownershipFilters contains ['id','task-messages'] and recorded the defect as an 'ADMIN-003 blocker' needing an explicit guard decision). ADMIN-014 is that guard decision. Replaced with a repaired-contract test plus a non-UUID-rejection test; the sender-attribution tests in that file are unchanged in intent and now use a real event UUID.
10 new tests in __tests__/admin/event-task-message-resource-scope.test.ts, all proven to fail on base SHA

It is a verification artifact, not product code, and is not imported by any build or runtime path. It should be deleted with the other lane slice configs once this evidence is accepted. No other path outside the working set was added or edited.
